visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair and pinkish highlights, wearing a white mesh top with blue bow details, holds a frosted skincare bottle in front of a light blue background featuring animated pink hearts. She smiles warmly at the camera. (2) The scene shifts to a studio setting where the same woman, now wearing a white textured blazer, sits at a white table. She demonstrates a skincare product by pumping it onto her hand, pointing to her face, and speaking directly to an off-screen person. On the table behind her, multiple bottles of the same product are visible in a neat row. (3) A brief shot returns to the original blue background with hearts, where the woman winks and points to her chin while holding the product. (4) A white screen appears where several rectangular boxes containing text and star ratings pop up sequentially to cover the frame. (5) The final phase shows a minimalist white screen with centered text, followed by a brand logo featuring green and black characters.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 用水氧精華跟我一樣穩定透亮肌. (2) [Logo]: 總監. [Subtitle]: 水氧接下來會改新包裝. (3) [Subtitle]: 居然是改這包裝好親切喔. (4) [Subtitle]: 這種壓頭好多了. (5) [Logo]: 總監. [Subtitle]: 我們就是為了讓年糕們使用起來更方便好用才換新包裝. (6) [Subtitle]: 那你按壓一下它的量. (7) [Subtitle]: 看看使用量是否跟平常一樣. (8) [Subtitle]: 喔! 新瓶器只要按1-2下就夠囉. (9) [Subtitle]: 你覺得要按多少量? 兩下差不多. (10) [Subtitle]: 而且我覺得水氧, 沒有什麼香精味. (11) [Subtitle]: 因為很多品牌做這種會有一種很濃的香精味. (12) [Subtitle]: 外加又濃稠. (13) [Subtitle]: 擦在臉上真的會毆打鼻子. (14) [Subtitle]: 但年零的這款水氧精華. (15) [Subtitle]: 或者覺得乾的地方. (16) [Subtitle]: 比如我下巴泛紅. (17) [Subtitle]: 我可能會擦了以後螺旋式的去按摩它. (18) [Subtitle]: 這樣子你疊擦的時候就不會有一個很濃很刺鼻的味道. (19) [Subtitle]: 我覺得這蠻重要的. (20) [Subtitle]: 就算每天用水氧還是覺得很舒服. (21) [Slogan]: 台灣妞代言 水氧活妍超修護精華. (22) [Variety]: 年糕們使用後的真心感受.
